# Andrea Carcano returns as Nozomi Networks CEO
![](https://image-optimizer.cyberriskalliance.com/unsafe/1920x0/https://files.cyberriskalliance.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Andrea-Carcano.jpg)

Andrea Carcano

According to SDx Central, Andrea Carcano has returned to Nozomi Networks to assume the role of CEO, replacing Edgard Capdevielle.
